title: Homan Hints at Federal Probe into Rep. Ilhan Omar, Claiming 'Things Are Going On'
snippet: Incoming border czar Tom Homan suggested that Minnesota Rep. Ilhan Omar is under criminal investigation, re-igniting partisan tensions in Washington.
content:
Incoming border czar Tom Homan suggested in a recent interview that U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar (D-MN) is currently the subject of a criminal investigation, fueling fresh political controversy in Washington. While offering limited specifics, Homan asserted that he is privy to information indicating authorities are looking into the Minnesota Democrat.

Tensions Flare Over Unconfirmed Claims

Speaking on the matter, Homan noted that "things are going on" behind the scenes regarding Omar, a high-profile member of the progressive group of lawmakers known as "The Squad." Conservative critics have previously raised questions regarding Omar's campaign finances and personal disclosures—accusations that the congresswoman has consistently dismissed as baseless, politically motivated attacks.

Reactions from Capitol Hill

Neither the Department of Justice nor Representative Omar's official team has publicly confirmed the existence of any active criminal investigation. Allies of Omar quickly pushed back against Homan's comments, accusing conservative figures of using unverified statements to target political opponents as the new administration prepares to assume office.
